memoryLane.demo: Watch the emojis light up in order, then tap them back in the same order.
memoryLane.step1: 👀 Watch the sequence of emojis carefully
memoryLane.step2: 🔄 Tap the emojis in the same order you saw them
memoryLane.step4: ❤️ A wrong tap costs one life and gives you a brand new sequence
memoryLane.step5: 🎯 Every level adds more items to remember — there is no limit, keep going!

routineBuilder.demo: First you'll see the correct order and why — then the steps get shuffled for you to rebuild.
routineBuilder.step1: 📖 Every round starts by showing you the correct order and a quick reason for each step
routineBuilder.step2: 🔄 Then the steps shuffle — drag them to put them back in order
routineBuilder.step3: ✅ Tap "Check My Order" when you're ready — no rush
routineBuilder.step4: 💡 Stuck? Tap "Need a Hint" any time
routineBuilder.step5: ❤️ A wrong order costs a life and gives you a new routine to try

patternQuest.demo: Figure out what comes next, then tap the matching option below.
patternQuest.step1: 🧩 Look at the pattern and figure out what comes next
patternQuest.step2: 🎯 Tap the symbol you think completes it
patternQuest.step3: ⭐ Chains of correct answers earn combo bonuses
patternQuest.step4: ❤️ A wrong guess costs a life and swaps in a fresh pattern
patternQuest.step5: 🎯 Patterns get trickier the further you go — no limit!

storyWeaver.demo: Read a short story, then answer a question or two about what happened.
storyWeaver.step2: ❓ Answer the question(s) about what happened
storyWeaver.step3: ⭐ A brand new AI-written story appears every round
storyWeaver.step4: ❤️ A wrong answer costs a life and brings a fresh story
storyWeaver.step5: 🎯 Longer stories with more questions appear as you level up

facePlace.demo: Tap a face on the left, then tap the place where they work on the right.
facePlace.step1: 👤 Step 1: Tap a face in the left column — it will glow blue
facePlace.step2: 📍 Step 2: Tap the matching place in the right column
facePlace.step3: ✅ A correct pair locks in and disappears from the board
facePlace.step6: 🎯 Each level adds more pairs and new faces/places!

cardFlip.demo: Flip two cards to find a matching pair. Remember the positions!
cardFlip.step1: 🎴 Tap any card to flip it — you can flip two at a time
cardFlip.step2: 🔍 Remember the emoji on each card
cardFlip.step3: ✅ Find a matching pair to remove both cards
cardFlip.step4: ⏰ You have a time limit — matching a pair gives you +10 bonus seconds
cardFlip.step5: ❤️ Running out of time costs a life!
cardFlip.step6: 🎯 Each level adds more cards — the challenge is infinite!

mindfulMoments.demo: Follow the on-screen cue: breathe in, then breathe out, at a gentle pace.
mindfulMoments.step1: 🧘 Take a moment to relax and breathe
mindfulMoments.step2: 🌬️ Follow the "breathe in" and "breathe out" cues
mindfulMoments.step3: ⭐ Completing a session always earns points and levels you up
mindfulMoments.step4: 🎯 Sessions get a little longer as you level up
mindfulMoments.step5: ☺️ There are no wrong answers here — just relax

privacy.description: Your data is safe with us

faqs.q1: How do I change the language?
faqs.a1: Click the globe icon (🌐) in the header, or go to Settings → Language. We support 11 Indian languages including Hindi, Assamese, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, and more.
faqs.a2: Yes! ReminiPlay works offline. Your progress is saved locally and synced when you reconnect.
faqs.q3: How do I reset my password?
faqs.a3: On the login page, click "Forgot Password?" and verify with your email or phone OTP. You can then create a new password.
faqs.q4: What is the Card Flip game?
faqs.a4: Card Flip is a memory matching game where you flip cards to find matching pairs before time runs out. Each match gives you +10 bonus seconds!
faqs.a5: You earn coins by: completing levels (random chance), earning combo bonuses (every 4 correct answers), and achieving high scores. Use coins to save lives!
faqs.a6: Yes! Caregivers and doctors have access to a dedicated dashboard showing patient cognitive scores, game performance, and real-time alerts.
faqs.q7: What happens if I lose all lives?
faqs.a7: You can continue from your last checkpoint (every 5 levels) or start over. You can also spend 5 coins to restore a life during gameplay.
faqs.a8: Absolutely. All patient data is encrypted and HIPAA/GDPR compliant. You control data sharing in Settings → Privacy.
